description: Fix rent data source inconsistency (Issue 1) and pass scenarioData to PredictionPanel (Issue 2). Currently, analysis uses financialData.expectedMonthlyRent but PredictionPanel uses marketData.averageRent. Also, user's scenarioData.priceGrowthRate/rentGrowthRate are not passed to prediction — it uses hardcoded assumptions instead.
steps: Step 1: In src/App.tsx, add scenarioData and financialData as new props to PredictionPanel (lines 192-198). Pass scenarioData={scenarioData} and expectedMonthlyRent={financialData.expectedMonthlyRent}.
Step 2: Update PredictionPanel interface (src/components/prediction/PredictionPanel.tsx) to accept new props: scenarioData: ScenarioData and expectedMonthlyRent: number.

Step 3: In PredictionPanel, use expectedMonthlyRent (user input) as the primary rent value for prediction instead of marketData.averageRent. Show both values for comparison: display marketData.averageRent as '市場行情' reference alongside user's expected rent.

Step 4: In usePrediction hook initialization, use scenarioData.priceGrowthRate and scenarioData.rentGrowthRate as the priceGrowthRateOverride and rentGrowthRateOverride in MacroAssumptions. This syncs user's scenario assumptions to the prediction model.
Step 5: Add UI indicator in PredictionPanel showing 'Using user scenario assumptions' vs 'Using macro model' when scenario overrides are active.
acceptance_criteria: PredictionPanel uses expectedMonthlyRent (user input) for rent predictions, not marketData.averageRent
PredictionPanel displays both user expected rent and market average rent for comparison
User's scenarioData.priceGrowthRate is applied to prediction calculations (override macro model)
User's scenarioData.rentGrowthRate is applied to prediction calculations (override macro model)
verification: Run `npm run build` — must complete with 0 errors
Manual test: Enter different values for 'Expected Monthly Rent' in FinancialForm vs market data, verify PredictionPanel uses user input and shows market comparison
Manual test: Change priceGrowthRate in ScenarioForm, verify prediction chart changes accordingly
findings:
Implemented successfully. Changes made:
1. App.tsx: Added scenarioData and expectedMonthlyRent props to PredictionPanel
2. PredictionPanel.tsx: Added ScenarioData and expectedMonthlyRent to interface, prioritizes user rent over market rent, added rent source indicator (User/Database icon) showing which value is used with comparison, added scenario override indicator when user growth rates are active
3. usePrediction.ts: Added scenarioData prop, useEffect to sync priceGrowthRate and rentGrowthRate as overrides when scenarioData changes, added isUsingScenarioOverrides to return value
Build completed with 0 TypeScript errors.
